summary: Iteration 66 - Testing large batch of features: HR module, sale deletion stock restore, finance nav visibility, campus switcher, resident search, residency toggle, sponsored children. All 22 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working.
seed_data_creation: Test products, salaries, contracts, and document requests created during testing were cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 66 verified all features: (1) Sale deletion restores stock - DELETE /api/sales/{id} correctly restores product stock via $inc. (2) Finance nav hidden when 'All Locations' selected - verified in Layout.jsx, Finance section only shows when activeCampus is set. (3) Dashboard financial summary hidden on 'All Locations' - verified with selectedCampus !== 'all' check. (4) Campus switcher shows sub-locations for non-admin directors - dropdown shows all campuses and sub-locations. (5) Resident assignment has searchable input - AccessPage.jsx searchResidents function queries both members API and children API, returns merged results with type labels. (6) LocationsPage sub-location form has 'Residential' toggle (allows_residents) - visible in sub-location properties section. (7) HR module fully functional: GET/POST /api/hr/salaries, POST /api/hr/payslips/generate, GET/POST /api/hr/contracts/templates, POST /api/hr/contracts/issue, POST /api/hr/document-requests, GET/PUT /api/hr/settings/{location_id}. (8) Sponsored children tracking: GET /api/hr/sponsored-children returns sponsored/total/percentage. (9) HRPage loads with 4 tabs: Salaries, Payslips, Contracts, Documents. (10) HR settings dialog has hr_enabled toggle, pay_frequency, pay_day fields.
